payload.summary: The incident involves a brute force attack on the account jdoe, but the successful login occurred after a documented change involving a password reset. This suggests that the successful login was likely due to the user updating their password following the change, rather than an attacker gaining access.

attack_chain.description: An attacker attempted to brute force the account jdoe using the source IP 10.80.0.15.

risk_factors: Successful login after a documented password reset
